entities.summary: Réhahn Croquevielle, commonly known as Réhahn, is a French photographer and art collector based in Hoi An, Vietnam. His work often focuses on themes such as memory, cultural heritage, and the documentation of traditional practices in countries including Vietnam, Cuba, Malaysia, and India. Réhahn was a painters & sculptors from Bayeux (b. 1979-05-04, Bayeux). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
